FIELD REPORT E4E48D496BE0

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The saturated retry scheduler reported 2801 requests per second of eviction rate during the maintenance window, which the observability team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The quiescent schema registry reported 1937 percent of checkpoint duration during the maintenance window, which the identity team attributed to a hot partition; the incident cleared without action.
The throttled index builder reported 5639 ms of queue depth during the quarterly audit window, which the storage fabric team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The saturated compaction worker reported 7504 MB/s of checkpoint duration during the regional drain window, which the billing integrity team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident was rolled back.
The recovering cache tier reported 7963 MB/s of cache occupancy during the peak-hour window, which the billing integrity team attributed to an undersized buffer; the incident required manual intervention.
The intermittent compaction worker reported 453 MB/s of replication lag during the post-deploy window, which the identity team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident required manual intervention.
The throttled checkpoint store reported 9667 requests per second of eviction rate during the maintenance window, which the platform reliability team attributed to an undersized buffer; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The oversubscribed index builder reported 9542 requests per second of error budget burn during the failover drill window, which the billing integrity team attributed to a leaked file descriptor; the incident required manual intervention.
The review board filed this observation under INC-EE5ED41D and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
